verdict.rationale: Docs show Gusto exposes a broad API (payroll runs, contractor payments, time-off requests with 'call the approve/decline endpoints directly from your own UI' as an alternative to the pre-built flow) alongside pre-built UI Flows, suggesting meaningful API parity for many workflows (gusto-docs-19, gusto-docs-38, gusto-docs-52). However, some integrations (e.g., 401(k) via Guideline) are described only as accessible via 'pre-built flows' links rather than raw API calls, and there is no explicit statement guaranteeing full feature parity between API and UI. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement/documentation confirming every UI-only action (e.g., benefits enrollment via partners like Guideline/SimplyInsured) has a direct API equivalent, and independent developer confirmation that no UI-exclusive features exist.
